items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And this one you had George Adams, Joe Ford, Charles Fambrough, and Sonship... [INTERVIEWER] ...John Stubblefield, Joe Ford, so you brought in- [INTERVIEWEE] The older guys.

ctx.x: Eric is a fellow Philadelphian and he had a good reputation. He was with Weather Report with Joe Zawinul, but as a person I really enjoyed having him in the band. He was very creative rhythmically. I mean he studied African music so he could play any of those rhythms from any of those tribes in Africa. He was very ethnically orientated, so that was great because I liked the African rhythms as well, so we kind of came together and we created an atmosphere rhythmically and harmonically as well because he was a good…
Now when you say Joe, are you talking about Joe Zawinul or Joe Ford?
Joe Zawinul, oh yeah that’s right, we got a lot of Joe’s here (laughs). This Joe that Joe.
